name: check-security-composer
description: Run Composer dependency security audit and report via reviewdog.

name.description: Name reported by reviewdog to identify this check.

reporter.description: Reporter of reviewdog command [github-pr-check,github-check,github-pr-review]. Defaults to the reporter resolved by setup-reviewdog for this run's context (github-pr-check on pull requests, github-check otherwise), which posts a Check annotation for every finding regardless of whether the PR touches the manifest file. Set explicitly to github-pr-review to post applyable version-bump suggestions instead, but only for findings on lines already part of the PR diff; everything else is dropped to a generic rolled-up comment.

fail-level.description: Exit code for reviewdog if it finds at least the specified level of diagnostic [none,any,info,warning,error].

max-diagnostics.description: Maximum number of vulnerability diagnostics to report, most severe first. Extra findings are collapsed into a single summary diagnostic to stay under GitHub's annotation limits.
